title: Treasury coupon announcement (month-end 2Y / 5Y / 7Y note + 2Y FRN reopening sizes, plus three bills)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF, text layer decompressed and rebuilt from per-glyph Td/Tm coordinates PER PAGE, direct 2026-09-05 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) — SEVEN rows carry the announcement date `Thursday, September 17, 2026`: `13-Week BILL` and `26-Week BILL` (auction Monday September 21, settlement Thursday September 24), `6-Week BILL` (auction Tuesday September 22, settlement Thursday September 24), `2-Year FRN R` (auction Wednesday September 23, settlement Friday September 25), `2-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday September 22), `5-Year NOTE` (auction Wednesday September 23) and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Thursday September 24), the three notes all settling Wednesday September 30. The per-page extraction step is what makes the bill tenors readable — grouping glyphs by y-coordinate across the whole document interleaves three month-blocks that share coordinates on different pages, which is why an earlier read of this same PDF declined to attribute bills. Corroborated independently from the auction record rather than a second document read: all four 2026 month-end coupon announcements carried exactly this seven-security shape (2026-05-21, 06-18, 07-23, 08-20 — same three bill tenors, same day-offsets, no 52-week in any), and the coupon auction dates are the ones treasury-2y-note-2026-09-22, treasury-5y-note-2026-09-23, treasury-7y-note-2026-09-24 and treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23 already carry. There is NO 52-week bill on this release — that tenor is announced 2026-09-24 (auction 09-29), from the same PDF and from the auction record's monthly 52-week cadence. Stays estimate on two counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the announcement press release on 2026-09-17 itself
notes: The missing sibling in an announcement series the calendar already tracks five members of (2026-09-03, 2026-09-10, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-22), and specifically the confirming primary for treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23, which is `estimate`-dated on a tentative schedule and had no dated event to attach its confirmation to. Also named by FT-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-22-1 as its `free out-of-sample pre-check, 35 days early`: sb0590's Sep-26 row `69 58 70 44 39 13 22 28` sizes this block, so a miss here kills that test before October begins. The four coupon numbers are therefore already in writing (2Y $69B, 5Y $70B, 7Y $44B, FRN reopening $28B = $211B) and the FRN leg is researched in its own ledger — the ONLY live number in this release is the bill leg, and per the 2026-09-05 initial research the obvious read of it is wrong: sb0590 says Treasury `expects to implement reductions to shorter-dated bill auction sizes during the month of September`, but those reductions were executed 2026-08-27 through 09-08 (6-week 95 to 85 to 75, 4-week 110 to 100 to 90, 8-week 100 to 90 to 85, minus $55B across three tenors) and the benchmark 13-/26-week bills held flat through every mid-September announcement in 2023, 2024 and 2025, stepping up only at month-end or in early October. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Structural notes for a later session: this announcement lands the day after the 2026-09-16 FOMC decision, on the final day of the communications blackout, and one day before the 2026-09-18 triple witching, while the 2026-09-17 10-Year TIPS auction prices roughly two hours after it — no intraday attribution to it is defensible. Its three notes plus that TIPS settle on Wednesday 2026-09-30, which is quarter-end, the government-funding-deadline-2026-09-30 date, PCE and the third Q2 GDP estimate. Discovered and filed by the treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23 initial research (2026-09-05); composition and bill-leg findings added by its own initial research the same day.
